DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES AS T WHERE T.TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND T.TABLE_NAME = 'VersionHistory')
	SET @SQL = N'
		SELECT TOP (1) CONCAT(VH.Major, ''.'', VH.Minor, ''.'', VH.Build, ''.'', VH.Revision) AS Version, NULL AS Branch, VH.UpdateDate
		FROM dbo.VersionHistory AS VH
		ORDER BY VH.VersionHistoryID DESC';
ELSE
	SET @SQL = N'
		SELECT TOP(1) 
			SL.Version, 
			CASE 
				WHEN CHARINDEX(''Script run on'', SL.Description) > 2 THEN SUBSTRING(SL.Description, 1, CHARINDEX(''Script run on'', SL.Description) - 2) 
				ELSE ''''
			END AS Branch,
			SL.DateApplied AS [Last Updated]
		FROM dbo.ScriptLog AS SL
		WHERE SL.Version <> ''0.0.0''
		ORDER BY
		    CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(SL.Version, 0, CHARINDEX(''.'', SL.Version))) DESC,
			CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''.'', SL.Version) + 1, CHARINDEX(''.'', SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''.'', SL.Version) + 1) - CHARINDEX(''.'', SL.Version) - 1)) DESC,
			CONVERT(DECIMAL(6,3), SUBSTRING(SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''.'', SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''.'', SL.Version) + 1) + 1, 1000)) DESC,
		    SL.DateApplied DESC';
EXEC sys.sp_executesql @stmt = @SQL;
